spans.s:
त्रुट् त्रुट्, cl. 6. 4. P. त्रुटति, त्रुट्यति,
तुत्रोट, त्रुटितुम्, to be torn or split, to
tear, break, burst, snap, fall asunder: Caus. P. A.
त्रोटयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to tear, break, cut, divide.

त्रुटि, इस्, f. (or त्रुटी, f. ?), cutting, breaking,
a tear, split; a small part, an atom or a visible atom
composed of three subtler elementary particles; a
very minute space of time, a moment, equal to (1/2)
[]
Lava, = (1/4) Kṣaṇa, = (1/40) Kāṣṭhā, = (1/400) Kalā, =
(1/4000) Nālikā, = (1/8000) Muhūrta, (or = (1/100) Vedha, =
(1/300) Lava, = (1/900) Nimeṣa, = (1/2700) Kṣaṇa, = (1/13500)
Kāṣṭhā, = (1/202500) Laghu, = (1/3037500) Nāḍikā, =
(1/6075000) Muhūrta); small cardamoms (Alpinia Car-
damomum), cardamoms from Guzerat; a sort of
tree; doubt, uncertainty; breaking (a promise); loss,
destruction; N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on
Skanda.
—त्रुटि-वीज, अस्, m. Arum Colocasia (=
कचु), an esculent root.
—त्रुटि-शस्, ind. in short
spaces of time.
—त्रुट्य्-अवयव, अस्, m. one half
of a Truṭi.

त्रुटित, अस्, आ, अम्, cut, broken, divided, hurt,
wounded, chapped, chafed.
—त्रुटित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
having cut or broken, &c.
त्रुड् त्रुड्, Ved. = त्रुट्, q. v.

त्रुप् त्रुप् or त्रुफ् or त्रुम्प् or त्रुम्फ्, cl.
1. P. त्रोपति or त्रोफति or त्रुम्पति or
त्रुम्फति, &c., to hurt, injure, kill; [cf. Gr. θρύπτω,
τρύφος: Lith. truppù, ‘to be worn away by friction;’
trumpas, ‘short;’ trumpinu, ‘to shorten.’]
